title: Alex West on hitting $1M, maps vs compasses, and what business success does and doesn't give you
summary: Alex West reflects on making his first $1M in revenue after six years of bootstrapping. He argues advice is a treasure map that ages badly, so rely on external maps early and your own compass as you gain experience. He is candid that the milestone felt anticlimactic and that his business was free-falling after a $50k/month peak.

principles.text: Early in a domain rely on other people's maps; as experience grows, trust your own intuition. Consult both, like a captain.
principles.quote: I believe that the earlier you are in your journey within a specific domain or subject, the more you have to rely on external knowledge.
